regressor_basis: The published capitalisation-weighted index of the exchange the share is listed on — the local index the beta rule asks for.
unused_note: The index series supplied ends 2026-07-24, before the last stock session used elsewhere in the study (2026-08-07). 2 weekly stock observations therefore fall outside the regression. The window stops where the index stops rather than pairing the stock against a stale index level.
composite_basis: ADX-listed names in the UAE library
window_note: The stock listed on 02-Jun-2023, so the longest window available is 3.18 years, short of the five-year target. The regression uses the full listed history.
weak_reason: R-squared = 15.8% against the 10% weak-instrument threshold; the 90% confidence interval [0.76, 1.41] spans 0.60x the point estimate

adopted.basis: tier-1 own-stock weekly regression (usability gate PASSED)
adopted.why: n = 161 weekly observations, R-squared = 0.158 against the 0.05 floor, SE(beta) = 0.199 against |beta| = 1.085. All three conditions of the usability gate are met, so the regression estimate is adopted rather than a default.
adopted.corroboration: Cross-checked three ways. (i) The Dimson sum-beta is 1.164 with a 90% interval of [0.57, 1.76]; the adopted 1.08 sits inside it. (ii) Regressing against an equal-weight composite of the exchange's own names instead of the published index gives 0.705 (R-squared 0.172), and against the wider ADX+DFM library 0.663 (R-squared 0.168). (iii) The sector prior for a listed tanker owner is 0.9-1.4 and for a contracted, fee-based marine services provider 0.5-0.9; the adopted figure is read against both in the study rather than accepted at face value.

composite_variant.note: Equal-weight composite of the exchange's own listed names, the subject excluded. This was the regressor before the published index was available; disclosed so the effect of the change is visible, not adopted.

full_library_variant.note: ADX + DFM equal-weight composite; disclosed, not adopted.

dimson.note: Dimson (1979) sum-beta over one lead, the contemporaneous term and two lags. The uplift over the contemporaneous OLS beta measures how much co-movement is booked late because the stock does not trade on every session.

self_inclusion_bias.note: The subject is a constituent of the published index it is regressed against, and on a capitalisation-weighted index that cannot be undone. The equal-weight proxy is run both ways to measure how large the resulting self-covariance is: the two figures here differ by 0.203, which is the scale of the upward pull the published-index beta also carries. It is disclosed rather than assumed away, and it works against the study's own conclusion, since removing it would lower the beta further.

thin_trading.note: Share of sessions closing unchanged, against the median of the UAE library. A high ratio is the documented mechanism for a downward-biased contemporaneous beta.

plausibility.mix_note: Roughly half of group revenue is contracted work for the parent group and half is exposed to spot and short-charter shipping markets, so an estimate between the two priors is the economically coherent answer.
